contract: §312 · §56m Whether the task toggle finds the tag someday on a line, and whether the indexer reads it there. `found` is what `task::tag::find_tag` (Rust, through `apply_tag`) and `lineHasTag` (TypeScript, `src/utils/tasks/task-tag-token.ts`) answer: a `#someday` with a boundary before it (start of line, whitespace or `(`) and no tag character after it (`md::is_tag_char`, and `TAG_CHAR_RE` there). `read` is whether `md::extract_inline_tags` reads the tag someday on the line. A row with `read` and not `found` is a line whose task carries the tag someday while the toggle cannot remove it; the agenda's `somedayVerdict` (`src/utils/tasks/task-triage.ts`) calls such a line `locked`. The Rust test `task::tag::tests::tag_boundary_table_is_shared_with_the_front_end` reads every row for both columns, and `src/utils/tasks/__tests__/task-tag-token.test.ts` reads `found`. Every character outside ASCII is written as a JSON unicode escape.
